segments.text: Open your accounting specialist, then look at Findings.
Choose Review action to inspect the proposed follow-up. Check the source before you continue.
When it looks right, create the follow-up task. Schoolbooks checks the invoice evidence again.
Open History, then choose Open follow-up task. The invoice record stays unchanged.
